| notes         = Its inestimable value comes from its rarity and history. Also known as the ''Cyclopmania Sword'', ''Cyc Sword'' and ''Godslayer''. This sword is not available from any monster or quest in the game.

The in game legend says that, many years ago, the evil god [[Brog]] enslaved [[Cyclopes]] to smith weapons for his perilous armies. In secrecy, the smiths created this powerful weapon in order to commit mutiny against their captor. They failed at the task of slaying Brog, however he was heavily wounded. Filled with unspeakable rage he cast the sword down into the lands of Tibia to be lost forever. While buried in Brog's flesh, it became covered with his horrible blood, which hardened the blade and enchanted the ''Godslayer'' with unmatched power. However, a dark curse has been cast upon the blade causing its owner to become stricken with awesome madness and horrible luck. It is said nothing good can come to he who possesses the mystical blade. 

<noinclude><gallery mode="nolines">
File:godslayer.jpg
| 1             = With {{character|Alex}}
File:Mls_cele.png
| 2             = {{character|Honken}}'s house
File:Moises the Dark MLS.png
| 3             = on {{character|Moises the Dark}}'s house along with other rares
File:Magic longsword.png
</gallery></noinclude>
| history       = The Magic Longsword first entered Tibia when Arieswar, Taghor and another very powerful person at that time were exploring the [[Plains of Havoc]] in search of a way to enter [[Knightwatch Tower]], with the knowledge that [[pick]]s would now open new holes. This was discovered by Taghor when, after an update, he went running around the areas surrounding [[Carlin]] and found a hole. He went down the hole and found [[Guido]] down there, who told him to go away. Taghor decided to return later only to find the hole no longer existed. Taghor began doing everything to the spot where the hole had been and eventually tried the pick.

After discovering the room currently known for containing the [[Ornamented Shield Quest]], they noticed a body under a [[fire field]]. Inside this body was a key to the Knightwatch Tower, a book, some assorted junk, and an item with a plain [[sword]] graphic. Upon further inspection of this sword, one-handed with attack 80 and defense 60, they soon realized just what they had stumbled upon. Taghor received a [[Magic Sword]] as compensation and attempts were made to keep this discovery quiet. Less than a week went by before Guido, furious that a map editor had hidden this weapon for himself, angrily demanded the weapon.

=== Second Discovery ===
The Magic Longsword was once again discovered, this time [[Arieswar]] found it in a killed [[Cyclops]]. Once again, this sword was also destroyed by [[CipSoft]] along with possibly other priceless items contained in Arieswar's depot.

=== Tibia Convention Award ===
The Magic Longsword finally resurfaced (with reduced stats of Atk: 55, Def: 40) and was awarded to {{character|Hagbard}} at the [[Tibia Convention 2001]] in Germany.

=== Auctions, sales, and robbery ===
* Hagbard decided to sell the sword, so he held an auction, which was won by {{character|Alex}} with a bid of 5.5 million gp.
* The sword was purchased for 5.5kk by Siobkerry, of Hokuten. 
* Siobkerry wanted to sell the sword for 7kk to Recca, but there was a problem. Tibia's first official war was going on, and it was {{Guild|Hokuten}}, vs. {{Guild|Satori}}, which was Recca's guild. Seeing as [[Safe Trade]] could not handle the amount of items necessary for this trade, it was decided that the only way the sword could be traded safely between these two enemies was for a middle man to do the trading. They called upon a renowned trader, Alex. Alex was only a lvl 20 druid, but he had been trading for so many years (before safe trade) that he was considered very trustable. There was one fatal flaw to Recca's plan, which was the key to Alex's plan... Alex was (secretly) also Strenni, a well known sorcerer who was a member of Hokuten. The trade went forward, with Siobkerry and Alex robbing all of the money from Recca, their enemy. The items could all be seen in the [[Dark Mansion]] for some time, as Hokuten was the original owner of it. This whole story has been since added to a book that can be found on the [[Isle of the Kings]] on books [[Legendary Curses VII.I (Book)]] and [[Legendary Curses VII.II (Book)]]
* It eventually belonged to {{Character|Moises the Dark}}, in [[Antica]].
* It got bought by {{Character|Rei de Lutabra}} around December, 2019, and was brought to [[Lutabra]].

=== Balancing ===
It was for a very long time the strongest non-throwable weapon in Tibia, besides the [[Ice Rapier]] which had 100 attack but would break in one hit. Later the Ice Rapier was changed to 60 attack, which was still stronger than the the Magic Longsword. Over the years, however, stronger weapons with additional attributes such as skill boosts and elemental damage were implemented, topping off the Magic Longsword.
}}
sources.title: Magic Longsword

{{Infobox Object|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Thunder Hammer | article = a | actualname = thunder hammer | plural = thunder hammers | itemid = 3309 | objectclass = Weapons | primarytype = Club Weapons | slot = Weapon Hand | flavortext = It is blessed by the gods of Tibia. | implemented = 6.4 | immobile = no | walkable = yes | pickupable = yes | usable = yes | levelrequired = 85 | hands = One | weapontype = Club | attack = 49 | defense = 35 | defensemod = +1 | imbueslots = 2 | upgradeclass = 4 | enchantable = no | weight = 125.00 | marketable = yes | droppedby = {{Dropped By|Morgaroth|Orshabaal|Morshabaal}} | value = 60.000.000 - 70.000.000 | npcvalue = 450 | npcprice = 0 | buyfrom = -- | sellto = H.L. | notes = | history = * It was for a long time one of the best one-handed [[Club Weapons|Club Weapon]] available. * The first person in Tibia who looted it was {{Character|Elahrion Avessar}} ([[Elysia]]). * In the past, only three such hammers existed. ** One was rewarded on [[Eternia]] together with a [[Golden Helmet]] for reporting a security bug ** One was a gift from the gods to the person responsible for the 2002 real life convention. That hammer was later given to Pytru as a Christmas gift in 2002. ** One was illegally gained by Warrax from the one shot [[Behemoth Quest]], using his bought [[GM]], Ender Speaker of the Dead. After Warrax's deletion, the hammer was sold. The buyer lost more then the hammer when he failed to heed the words from GM Flattery, losing his depot along with the hammer when CIP found him. * A Thunder Hammer existed on [[Premia]], entering through the Demon Quest that was located in today's [[Vampire Shield Quest]] that CipSoft created to get more people interested in Premia. The hammer was gained and sold by a Premian char named Morak. === World of Tibia Forum ==== The history of this hammer was best summed up by [[World of Tibia|WoT]]: Khundahamar, The Thunder Hammer
"In the times of dread some of the best dwarven smiths were hold captive by the forces of Blog. They were forced to teach the secrets of smithing to Blogs children, the cyclopses. Kazrad Rockfist, a dwarven hero, braved many dangers to find the hidden underground forges. He sneaked in and managed to free the captives, but as they made a run to the exit, they found the steel doors sealed shut. With the rampaging cyclopses of Blog in their back the dwarf begun to pray to their gods and in the last minute they got an answer from the heavens. Kazrads hammer became blessed, and with a single mighty hit the hero shattered the doors, allowing all captives to escape. Wielded in many battles as a symbol of the fight against the cyclopses, the hammer was lost. The dwarves call this artefact Khundahamar, which means ''liberator'' but its only known as the ''Thunderhammer'' by the humans."
==== Gallery ==== Thsolera.JPG | 1 = The TH of Solera }}

| history       = * The Shield of Honor was introduced to the game on {{OfficialNewsArchive|119|January 7th, 2002}} as a gift for those who purchased a premium account of 7 months. This prize was the first and last offered by Cipsoft, as they received many complaints from players that Cip was selling wealth. This item was a special promotion for Tibias 5th anniversary and as a kick start to the introduction of premium accounts started only three months earlier.
* Some facts about this shield from the past:
** 2002 - 157 of this shield existed.
** 2004 - 120 of this shield existed
** It is unknown how many shields existed by 2012.
* Many shields were eventually deleted/removed because of inactive players. Three were given at the Germany Tibia Convention as prizes and the winners were allowed to select which server the items would be placed on, all three choosing [[Premia]].
* 20 Shields of Honour were awarded on a {{OfficialNewsArchive|3809|Rhyme Contest}} during [[Tibia's 20th Anniversary]] celebrations.
* A shield of honour was awarded to {{character|Mytherin}}, in February 2017, for developing Tibialyzer.
* As announced on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8849|June 16, 2026}}, the [[Updates/15.25.3a4a52|Vocation Adjustments Update 2026]] raised its defense from 33 to 43.
}}

| notes         = It's a decent armor for anyone looking to save capacity. It can be used by any vocation but there are usually better armors available.

*[[Druid]]s and [[Sorcerer]]s can use [[Ethno Coat]], [[Spirit Cloak]], [[Focus Cape]].
*[[Knight]]s can use [[Golden Armor]], [[Dragon Scale Mail]], [[Demon Armor]].
It may be a good option for a low-level knight who only blocks more damage in armor upgrades, while the other vocations improve their skills to deal more damage. The extra capacity will allow the knight to carry more potions.

It was very attractive for [[Mage]]s before the [[Updates/8.2|Summer Update 2008]]. Most mages now prefer to use a [[Spirit Cloak]] or [[Focus Cape]] for the extra [[Magic Level]] although [[Spirit Cloak]]s are heavier and have less defense and [[Focus Cape]]s have less defense but is lighter. On the [[Test Server]] ([[Updates/8.2|8.2]]), Blue Robe added an extra [[Magic Level]], however the convenience was removed after the Test Server. Many people believed that these robes increased magic damage by 25%, however this rumor was (and is) false.
Obtainable in the [[Medusa Shield Quest]].

records.description: This strange creature has the tendency to set certain things on fire.

sources.raw_infobox:
{{Infobox Object|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Fire Bug | article = a | actualname = fire bug | plural = fire bugs | itemid = 5467 | objectclass = Tools and other Equipment | primarytype = Tools | flavortext = This strange creature has the tendency to set certain things on fire. | implemented = 7.8 | lightradius = 3 | lightcolor = 205 | immobile = no | walkable = yes | pickupable = yes | usable = yes | weight = 30.50 | stackable = no | marketable = yes | droppedby = {{Dropped By|}} | value = 100 | npcvalue = 0 | npcprice = 100 | buyfrom = Evan | sellto = -- | notes = This tool is used for burning [[Sugar Cane]] fields before harvesting them to make [[Rum]]. It will sometimes explode upon use, causing 5 damage to the user and being destroyed in the process. Also provides 3 squares of permanent yellow light and can light up [[Empty Coal Basin]]s. Also, when you use it successfully, it won't necessarily disappear. So it's possible to use the same fire bug multiple times. Moreover, it doesn't seem to be able to explode during quests (like [[Machinery of War Quest]]).

Each fire bug can burn around 20 fields of sugar cane based on a test done by a player in which he bought 100 bugs and managed to burn 2011 fields. This item is also used in the [[Meriana Quest]], [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]], [[Treasure Hunt Quest]], [[Machinery of War Quest]], [[Tower Defence Quest]], [[Secret Service Quest]] (For TBI), [[Blood Brothers Quest]], and [[Kissing a Pig Quest]].

}}

It can be decorated using any sort of fruit, and once placed a candlestick onto it, it becomes a [[Party Cake]].
'''How to make a Decorated Cake''' To make a ''Decorated Cake'', you need... [[Flour]] (can be gotten by harvesting [[wheat]] in a [[millstone]])
[[Milk]]
[[Oven]]
A [[Fruit]] (check table of fruits you may use [[Cooking#Fruits for Decorated Cake and Fruit Juice|here]])
[[Kitchen Knife]]
1. Get the milk into a [[trough]] or [[bucket]].
2. Use flour with milk. You will get [[Lump of Cake Dough|cake dough]].
3. Use the cake dough with an oven. You will get a [[cake]].
4. Use the knife on a [[fruit]] (check table of fruits you may use [[Cooking#Fruits for Decorated Cake and Fruit Juice|here]]) while having the cake in your [[backpack]]. If you've done this correctly, there will now be red decorations on your cake, forming your ''Decorated Cake''.

Note: You can make it become a [[Party Cake]] by placing a [[Candlestick]] onto it.

{{Clear}} One of these is needed during the [[Krailos Quest]].
Create 20 of these to obtain the [[With a Cherry on Top]] [[achievement]] and half of the [[Piece of Cake]] achievement. }}

| droppedby     = {{Dropped By|Acolyte of Darkness|Bane of Light|Bride of Night|Doomsday Cultist|Duskbringer|Eclipse Knight|Herald of Gloom|Midnight Spawn|Midnight Warrior|Nightslayer|Shadow Hound|Weak Spawn of Despair}}
| value         = 1,000 - 30,000

| notes         = It can be obtained throughout and as reward of [[The Lightbearer]] event.

Can be traded for [[experience]] points with [[Lucius]] during and after succeeding in [[The Lightbearer]] event. A [[Game World]] that has failed the event can not exchange them. 

For each Midnight Shard, characters can gain <math>300 \cdot L</math> experience; L being the character's level. Note that the formula is not <math>\sum_{i=1}^{N} 300L_i</math> (for N shards), so if a character levels up by using one shard, they will gain 300 more experience per shard for the next level. Thus, it is slightly better to trade them incrementally than all at once. Check the [[Midnight Shard/Table|table]] for better results. 

A character can trade up to 80 shards for experience per year. However, an arbitrary amount of shards can be traded for gold.
| history       = ==== 2009 ====
Previously, the shards gave <math>30 \cdot L</math> experience and was also lootable from monsters on the good side of the [[Temple of Light]] if the event ends in success. The adjustment came as a result of the raising of the shards' rarity.

==== 2011 ====
During 2011, some players could trade up to 80 shards. Players who had not talked to Lucius yet after the {{OfficialNewsArchive|1892|November 12 patch}} could have their shard trade count reset after their next conversation with Lucius. For example, if one took 80 shards with them to Lucius, asked to trade all for experience, 40 would be traded; ending the conversation with 'bye' and repeating the process with the 40 remaining shards would allow the final 40 to be traded for experience. This was not a bug - it is the compensation for a bug in which some players could not trade 40 shards.

==== 2024 ====
{{OfficialNewsArchive|7987|The August 6 2024 patch}} increased the number of tradable shards from 40 to 80 and removed the level cap (of 200) for redeeming midnight shards.
}}

sources.raw_infobox:
{{Infobox Object|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tome of Knowledge | article = a | actualname = Tome of Knowledge | plural = Tomes of Knowledge | itemid = 10217 | objectclass = Household Items | primarytype = Books | secondarytype = Quest Items | flavortext = Bring this encrypted book to a sage in Farmine to gain wisdom or unlock more of Zao's culture. | implemented = 8.54 | immobile = no | walkable = yes | pickupable = yes | weight = 15.00 | marketable = yes | droppedby = {{Dropped By|}} | value = 5,000 - 50,000 | npcvalue = 0 | npcprice = 0 | buyfrom = -- | sellto = -- | notes = These books are valuable and sought after by certain players. A few of them are extremely hard to get hold of.
Obtainable in the [[Tomes of Knowledge Quest]]. You need to hand these books in to NPC [[Cael]] by saying "{{KW|Tome of Knowledge}}" to unlock trading abilities with [[Farmine]] NPC's and earn other rewards. You can only give one Tome of Knowledge to him every 20 hours in real time.
Rewards for handing the tomes into NPC [[Cael]]: *'''1st Tome''': [[Dragon Tapestry]]
Allows you to buy [[Dragon Tapestry|Dragon Tapestries]] from NPC [[Pompan]] for 80 [[gp]] each. *'''2nd Tome''': [[Minotaur Backpack]]
Allows you to buy [[Minotaur Backpack]]s from NPC [[Pompan]] for 200 [[gp]] each and sell him lizard flags. *'''3rd Tome''': [[Lizard Weapon Rack]]
Allows you to buy [[Lizard Weapon Rack]] from NPC [[Esrik]] for 500 [[gp]] each. *'''4th Tome''': [[Rice Ball]]s
Allows you to trade a [[Bunch of Ripe Rice]] for 10 [[Rice Ball]]s with NPC [[Swolt]]. This can be repeated as often as you like, as long as you have a [[Bunch of Ripe Rice]] to give to [[Swolt]]. *'''5th Tome''': [[Dragon Backpack]]
Allows you to buy [[Dragon Backpack]]s from NPC [[Pompan]] for 200 [[gp]] each. *'''6th Tome''': [[War Drum]] & [[Didgeridoo]]
Allows you to buy [[War Drum]]s (for 1000 [[gp]] each) and [[Didgeridoo]] (for 5000 [[gp]] each) from NPC [[Cael]]. '''You need to have finished [[The New Frontier Quest]] in order to hand in the rest of the tomes''' *'''7th Tome''': Snake Head Teleport
Handing in 7 Tomes you will allow you to use the snake teleport at the peak of the mountain, inside of which [[Farmine]] is located. It takes you to the [[teleport]]er in northern [[Zao]], south of the [[Dragonblaze Peaks]] which is the [[teleport]]er to [[Muggy Plains]]. The snake head teleport is a one-way teleport '''only'''! *'''8th Tome''': [[Corruption Hole]]
Allows you to enter a hole in the north-eastern end of [[Zao]], where you can find many [[Lizard Chosen]] as well as 4 [[Ghastly Dragon]]. *'''9th Tome''': Lizard Weapons
Allows you to sell [[Zaoan Helmet]], [[Zaoan Armor]], [[Zaoan Legs]], [[Zaoan Shoes]], [[Drakinata]], [[Traditional Sai]]s, [[Zaoan Sword]], [[Drachaku]], [[Twin Hooks]], [[Zaoan Halberd]] and [[Wailing Widow's Necklace]] to NPC [[Esrik]]. *'''10th Tome''': [[Zao Palace]]
Allows you to enter the [[Zao Palace]]. It is situated deep underground, below the mountain base of the Lizards. You will find [[Ghastly Dragon]]s there, but before you get to them you will have to fight your way through hordes of [[Draken Warmaster]]s and [[Draken Spellweaver|Spellweaver]]s. *'''11th Tome''': [[Dragon Statue (Item)|Dragon Statue]]
Allows you to buy a [[Dragon Statue (Item)|Dragon Statue]] from NPC [[Cael]] after you bring him a [[Red Lantern]]. *'''12th Tome''': [[Dragon Throne]]
NPC [[Cael]] will now make a [[Dragon Throne]] for you after you bring him a [[Red Piece of Cloth]]. There is a time limit on the [[Dragon Throne]] and [[Cael]] will only make them once every 5 weeks (35 days) for you. *'''More than 12 Tomes''': If, by any chance, you are able to get more than 12 Tomes, you can still hand them in to NPC [[Cael]]. He will reward you with 5000 [[experience]] points for each extra tome you give to him, but still only one is allowed every 20 hours in real time. | history = Before [[Updates/9.83|Update 9.83]], Tomes of Knowledge could only be turned in every 24 hours instead of 20. }}

{{Infobox Object|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Diapason | article = a | actualname = diapason | plural = ? | itemid = 12547 | objectclass = Tools and other Equipment | primarytype = Taming Items | flavortext = A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it. | implemented = 9.10 | immobile = no | walkable = yes | pickupable = yes | usable = yes | weight = 2.00 | stackable = no | marketable = yes | droppedby = {{Dropped By|}} | value = 15,000 - 150,000 | npcvalue = 0 | npcprice = 0 | buyfrom = -- | sellto = -- | notes = A [[Diapason]] can be used to tame a [[Crystal Wolf]]. Note: It has a chance of breaking when used.
If you're successful, you'll see the message: {{Sound|The smooth sound of the diapason tamed the crystal wolf.}}
[[Edala]] will give this item to [[Character]]s who plays a [[Lyre]] near her 7 times, each time being at least 24 hours (real life time) apart. Someone can only receive one Diapason per character. {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Transcripts {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} {{Infobox Transcript|1st day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: Ashari, ''Player''. How... nice to see a human taking interest in a beautiful art such as music.

2nd day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: Ashari, ''Player''... that sound was.. interesting.

3rd day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: Ashari, ''Player''. You've made some... progress playing the lyre, haven't you..? I want to believe you have.

4th day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: ''Player''. My regular visitor. I certainly... appreciate your efforts to entertain me, but let me assure you, I'm quite comfortable up here by myself. Alone. In silence.

5th day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: Ashari, ''Player''. I'm starting to feel a little sorry... for your lyre. Being forced to produce such noise must be a tragic fate.

6th day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: ''Player''! You're driving me insane! I beg you, take your lyre away from this sacred and peaceful place.

7th day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: AAAARGH! ''Player''! My ears! I'd prefer listening to drunken dwarves rambling all day to the sound of your lyre! Please, at least get it tuned. Here, you can have this elvish '''diapason'''.}} }}
sources.title: Diapason

{{Infobox Object|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Sugar Oat | actualname = sugar oat | plural = ? | itemid = 12802 | objectclass = Tools and other Equipment | primarytype = Taming Items | flavortext = A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it. | implemented = 9.10 | immobile = no | walkable = yes | pickupable = yes | usable = yes | weight = 2.00 | stackable = yes | marketable = yes | droppedby = {{Dropped By|Bane Lord}} | value = 10 - 200 | npcvalue = 0 | npcprice = 0 | buyfrom = -- | sellto = -- | notes = Used to tame a [[Wild Horse]]. Can be obtained by combining [[Bunch of Sugar Cane|sugar cane]] and [[Bunch of Wheat|wheat]]. Failed: '''The wild horse happily munches the sugar oat and runs on.'''
Failed: '''Weeeheeeehee.'''
Failed: '''With its last strength the horse the horse runs to safety.'''
Succeeded: '''The horse eats the sugar oat and accepts you as its new master.'''
'''How to make Sugar Oat''' To make Sugar Oat, you will need a [[Sickle]], a [[Scythe]], a [[Bunch of Sugar Cane]], [[Wheat]] and a [[Fire Bug]]. 1. Travel to [[Liberty bay]] and buy [[Fire Bug]]s from Evan {{Mapper Coords|126.3|128.113|7|3|text=here}}.
2. Go to the [[Sugar Cane]]s {{Mapper Coords|125.227|128.29|7|2|text=here}} and use the [[Fire Bug]]s to burn the [[Sugar Cane]]s down.
3. Pick up the Bunch of Sugar Canes using [[Sickle]] and travel to [[Thais]] wheat field {{Mapper Coords|126.181|125.246|7|4|text=here}}.
4. Cut down the wheat with the [[Scythe]].
5. Use the [[Bunch of Wheat]] on the [[Bunch of Sugar Cane]]. Note: You can use the Sugar Oats on [[Wild Horse]] to get the [[War Horse]] mount.{{Ilink|War_Horse}}
}}
sources.title: Sugar Oat

| notes         = You can exchange them for [[Premium Time]], Extra Services ([[Sex Change]], [[Name Change]], [[World Transfer]] and [[Express World Transfer]]), [[Blessings]], [[Potions]], [[Runes]], [[Mounts#Bought Mounts|Mounts]], [[Store#Outfits|Outfits]], [[Store#House Equipment|House Equipment]], [[XP Boost]] and ''Useful Things'' ([[Charm Expansion Offer]], [[Instant Reward Access]], [[Prey Bonus Reroll]], [[Permanent Prey Slot]], [[Gold Pouch]], [[Gold Converter]] and [[Temple Teleport]]) via the [[Store]]. They can be traded with other players via the [[Market]]. Once bought, they are available to all characters of the same account no matter the [[Game World]] and it's also possible to transfer them to any player anywhere. Tibia Coins are therefore the only items which can cross server boundaries. They are also only items for which free players can place 'buy'-offers in the market and the only items to hold a Market category of their own. 

After 3 years an account hasn't been used, all Tibia Coins on it are deleted. Several emails are sent beforehand to the account's email address warning inactive players about this procedure. A single login before the 3 years are over will prevent the deletion of the Tibia Coins.

'''Note:''' Two asterisks (**) after a payment method name indicate that Tibia Coins bought with this service will only become transferable 6 months after their purchase. These methods include ''BoaCompra Gold'', ''Boku'' (appears as ''Mobile Payment'' on the Webshop), ''Boleto Bancário'' and ''PagSeguro''. Depending on the country, ''Credit/Debit Card'' and/or ''PayPal'' may also sell temporarily untransferable Tibia Coins, so pay attention to the asterisks.
}}

| droppedby     = {{Dropped By|}}

| npcprice      = 0
| buyfrom       = --
| sellto        = --
| notes         = This item can be obtained by using [[The Cobra Amulet]] on an [[Intricate Cobra Shrine]] located inside a hidden crypt north of [[Ankrahmun]]. The crypt can be accessed by using a [[Shovel]] {{Mapper Coords|text=here|129.77|127.119|7|4|1|0.250.25}}. When this item was released, its creator [[Lionet]] {{post|38769695|explained}} what's behind its story:

:''I really appreciate the interest of the Tibia Community in our lore and stories! Here are some additional notes on my story of Scarlett and Galthen:''

:''The Cobra amulet is an extremely powerful artifact with an unknown origin as of now. Its traits are concentrated on a single individual but the curse will affect all things directly connected to the amulet and its wearer. When the amulet is returned to its eternal resting place, everything the taker, thus owner, of the amulet has experienced from that point in time onward will be undone. All of this, as already mentioned, will only affect events in direct relation to the bearer of the amulet and the bearer him- or herself.''

:''In the case of Scarlett and Galthen, Scarlett was blinded towards Galthen while in turn a successful search for Scarlett was impeded by the amulet. Returning it to its resting place will alter the timeline for Scarlett (and also Galthen who is directly connected to the Scarlett, the amulet and ultimately the curse). So in their world, the events after the crypt never took place. Everything before that will still have happened. However, without the power of the Cobra, Scarlett will not continue the assassin path much further and she, as well as Galthen, will have the possibility to find each other. Both their searches would eventually be successful as they belong together.''

:''By chosing to return the amulet, players are effectively building a somewhat happy ending for the two but will lose the amulet. That is why the note says: "You are truly selfless".''
| history       = This item could not be equipped as an amulet until [[Updates/12.20.9066|November 19, 2019]], when it was changed.
}}
